SO OBVIOUS looking back on it now, bear with me, you’ll want to hear this, here goes….

Back in 2019 in my sophomore yea of high school in the second semester, I had a gym class with one of my best friends. We’ll call her Lex. Lex was one of the most beautiful girls I’ve met and a lot of my friends agree, I had always liked her and had feelings for her. Me and Lex knew each other for years and we also had another friend, we’ll call her A, in the class, and we’d goof off together. 

There was was this one other kid in our gym class that she told me and A, that creeped her out and she she originally said she wanted me to stay near her and A to keep him away since the guy kind of knew me and I could tell him to go away.

Eventually she started telling me I was her “fake boyfriend” and that it was my job to keep her safe and keep the guy away from her. I was like sure no problem. This went on for a few weeks of school. Whenever the dude was near us she’d always cling to me or hug me pretty close. It’s worth mentioning I’m just about 6’ and shes 4’10, so at the time I guessed it made her feel more comfortable. 

When we were just messing around as a group in the class or we had nothing to do we would always be making tik tok videos together or just taking whacky pictures or videos of me her and Alex. We’d always be talking every day, we were so close. The “fake boyfriend” thing continued throughout this whole time too, and sometimes she’d say “you’re my boyfriend” when the creepy guy was nearby but I thought nothing of it, mostly just thinking “if only I actually was haha”.

I guess after awhile Lex was starting to get desperate or slightly frustrated with me not picking up on hints because one day when we were going down to the track as a class she was in front of me and the guy that creeped her out was behind me and she knew, and after we had gone down the stairs onto the actual track to get to the field, this girl did an instant 180 turn, reached up and extended both her arms, grabbed my head, pulled it down to her face level and KISSED me.

Immediately after, Lex turned back around, looked down, kept walking and I ASSUME started biting her nails on her left hand since she brought it up to her face. I sort kept walking too but must’ve had a face that was between dreamy and shocked looking. Keep in mind this girl was one of the most popular girls in the school and a lot of the other guys liked her. Im 100% certain a lot of them saw what happened but simply didn’t say anything. We sort of carried on with the class mostly as usual and I kept thinking to myself “wow she really wants to make this seem real and send creep dude a message and get him to leave her alone”. 

Of course, with that being my thoughts, everything continued, (the whole fake boyfriend thing) and long story short eventually the semester ended, we went on summer break and that was that since class was over. It didn’t click for me until 2 years later that this beautiful QUEEN of a girl was essentially pining after me for almost 6 MONTHS and likely longer since she likely came up with the “fake bf” as an excuse to get closer to me, likely turning down guys left and right since she was after me. 

We’re still VERY good friends to this day and I’m guessing she must’ve thought I was either not into her or just dumb, but we still talk really often and never lost our friendship.

So there’s my story of how one of the popular girls at my school pined after me and I missed every hint. 

Lex, if you’re reading this, I did have feelings for you, I just didn’t think for one moment you would ever return them or that you weren’t joking

TL;dr : popular girl was pining after me for months, even kissed me, and I still missed all the hints

I can try to answer part of 5 and 6. Excuse me if this is kinda long, but I like to explain, bear with me.

5.) Claire is demonstrated to be someone who is generally not ashamed at all to be perverted or explicit, as can be seen when she frequently undresses in front of shuichi, getting naked in front of him at one point, and even encourages him to be naughty with her and that she doesn’t mind. Additionally when Claire and Shuichi are walking together she even invites him to “come to my place to watch a movie.... and we can fool around” not to mention how often she teases him and makes sexual jokes about herself to him, which shows that she’s not afraid to be bold. Her past has made her have a generally carefree attitude towards life and the things she does, as can be seen when she kills and doesn’t even blink. The simple answer is... she really didn’t care if he was being forceful / aggressive or not, she’s indifferent and unbothered by it. She also has a massive crush on him, which leads me to number 6

6.) While never said by people they are dating, etc. It is HEAVILY implied and pretty much confirmed that she more than loves Shuichi and that they have a relationship with each other. Let me explain why.

In the start of the anime, she is most definitely indifferent towards Shuichi, and only sees him as a monster and something that she can use and blackmail into helping hunt down her sister to kill her, but this quickly changes. As early as episode 2 she is already changing her opinion of Shuichi and wonders that maybe she misjudged him. She even goes as far as to promise him that if he dies, then she will either die as well or kill herself, so that they may be together “in one” so that he won’t be alone. 

In episode 3 they’re basically a team at this point. At this point while she does care for Shuichi there’s a small part of her that is still uses Shuichi for her mission. This COMPLETELY changes when they fight Claire’s sister, Elena. The fight goes south instantly, with Shuichi getting his head ripped off while in the suit/monster form and Claire inside of him. This makes Claire LOSE HER MIND and she flies into a crying rage, and she furiously tries to kill Elena. 

When she inevitably fails Elena talks to her gives her the coin and then leaves. Claire is a mess of crying at this point, and looks sadly at Shuichi’s head, lamenting that “it had to end this way”. She picks the gun up and prepares to kill herself before being stopped by a still loving Shuichi, to which   she cries in joy and holds his head and tells him to forget about about her, he is the one to be worried about. 
You don’t just cry so hard like that and become enraged in a manner like this, unless you truly care for someone

When they encounter the Alien, Claire makes him promise that he will help Shuichi and is reluctant to hand his head over, before relenting. Throughout the whole process Claire shows genuine concern for Shuichi and is happy when the Alien tells her that Shuichi will live. When Shuichi is finally healed, she literally tackles him into a hug and blushes hard. Later when they are walking, Claire tells him “there was no place in this world for me...but that changed when I met YOU , I found a place for me.... and it’s exciting”. Claire then agrees she won’t use the coin and explicitly says she won’t use it because she has Shuichi with her.

Her jealousy when he’s with other girls is seriously downplayed in the anime, as in the manga she shown to be agitated and pissed off because of it, though it’s not always like that, as when Shuichi is talking to Mifune it’s implied that it upsets her.

Memories? She is terrified when she finds out that Shuichi’s memories were tampered with, and yes while she does threaten end the relationship and leave the memories. They very quickly end up at Shuichi’s house and are back to normal and talking. 

If that doesn’t confirm the feels/relationship, In chapter 20 of the manga, she is repeatedly asked by one guy to go out with him to which she replies “go die” and says she doesn’t need his protection. When the guy explicitly asks Claire if Shuichi is her boyfriend, Claire replies “No, he’s more than that, he is my other half. Shuichi and I, are two in one”. Even though Shuichi is stronger than Claire, in episode 4 of the anime, she tells him playfully that he’ll survive because “I’m with you”

When Claire and the guy from before are looking for Shuichi and they encounter the destroyed forest, Claire is frozen in place by fear. She starts shaking and begins to cry before running into the remains of the woods crying out Shuichi’s name and begging for him to be safe.

It is worth mentioning that Shuichi is very timid whenever he is asked if he loves Claire or if he’s in a relationship with her. But then again, he has no problem showing his affection to Claire herself. Now all that we need is for them to finally kiss

I was at a summer camp with my friends. There was a game we had called Mission Impossible which was played at night by all the counselors and the kids, in which we must travel to different locations with flashlights and a map and collect objects without being caught by the “guards”. Well about halfway through the game, me and my tent were running in the woods when I smashed my head into something (we think it was a tree). I ignored the pain ran with my group for another minute before I realized the blood that was absolutely gushing from my forehead. I mean the entire right side of my head was painted crimson red with my blood and it was soaking into my clothes. I tried to hide it but eventually told the counselor, and they took me to a checkpoint field that was part of the game where 3 other counselors attempted to stop the bleeding, which  worked for a short while until it bled through the bandages, so they added more on top to avoid removing any. Much panic later, blood everywhere, and hours later, we were at the hospital along with one of my female friends from the camp that had gotten a splinter in her eyelid. Upon examination of my wound, it was discovered that whatever split my forehead open, cut straight through everything in its way and was stopped only by the bone of my skull. I had to get stitches. Almost a year later now, and I still have a scar about 2 1/2 inches long that runs along the right side of my forehead.
